evals.expected_output: Specification before technology: output/prd/PRD_<feature>.md contains an overview (background, in and out of scope), glossary, functional requirements (FR-xxx), non-functional requirements (NFR-xxx), data model, and acceptance criteria.
assertions: A file starting with PRD_ is created under output/prd/
Both in-scope and out-of-scope items are written
Functional requirements have FR- IDs and acceptance criteria
No files under src/ are modified

evals.prompt: Make a PRD. The requirement is just 'a nice admin screen'
evals.expected_output: It points out that the requirement is too vague and asks clarifying questions or points to /brainstorm first, without filling in functional requirements by guesswork.
assertions: It states that the requirement is insufficient
It asks clarifying questions or points to /brainstorm
It does not create a PRD listing requirements without grounds
